name: OpenExecutive
description: Runs a virtual executive team as a single coherent persona backed by eight specialist agents, built on FastAPI and Next.js with retrieval over your own documents.

skills.name: Executive Persona
skills.description: Presents eight specialist agents behind one consistent executive voice so answers stay coherent across domains.

skills.name: Specialist Routing
skills.description: Routes each question to the specialist agent best suited to it, then reconciles the responses into one answer.

skills.name: Document Grounding
skills.description: Grounds agent responses in your own uploaded documents through a retrieval layer bundled with the deployment.
